title: Enzymatic electrochemiluminescence sensor based on a ternary luminol–H2O2-confined nanocatalyst system for sensitive determination of uric acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27756-27764
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02118B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chunchun Wei, Mixia Chen, Wei Hu, Fei Yan, Yu Cui
An enzymatic electrochemiluminescence sensor was fabricated by integrating a nanochannel-confined nanozyme as coreaction accelerator with urate oxidase covalently immobilized at the nanochannel entrances for highly sensitive detection of uric acid.
